ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake - SW Sea Beasts
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
SW_SEA_MONSTERS_ART_1 — 18 Naboo/Star Wars sea creatures across six roles: silt ambushers (the opee family), harpooners (the colo family), leviathans (the sando family), shoal grazers (the canon scalefish), a scavenger swarm, and colossal filter-feeder neutrals. Every stat, tool and lifeStage is calibrated in `design/Jawa/worldbuilding/sea_beasts_def_spec.md` against a named vanilla animal and the 1.6 C# source.
Ships as plain seafloor-map animals per the ruled aquatic-movement decision (aquatic_movement_routes.md, OK card, 2026-09-02): zero C#, no swimmer pathgrid. The five vanilla water fields (waterSeeker, waterCellCost, canFishForFood, moveSpeedFactorByTerrainTag, swimmingGraphicData) let them swim shallow water on any map today; they do not yet wild-spawn (no wildBiomes — RM_SeafloorBiome does not exist yet), so all 18 are dev/bridge-spawn only until that biome ships.
Two of the eighteen — Starmaw and Lanternwhale — have no art yet (ChatGPT usage limit stopped generation mid-set, see `art/final/README.md`); their defs are complete and their texPath already points at the folder the art will land in.
RimStarWars tier per NAMING_SCHEME_PLAN.md.
